summary: Lake County, OR: a 1922 lookout house moved to Morgan Butte in 1958; an OMNI range station took the site in 1959. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 14'x14' L-4 lookout house per FFLOS (1930 replacement); firelookout.com gives a 14x14' cab for 1930 without naming the type; the Oregon lookouts page gives a 12x12 house in 1922 and no 1930 change
facts.status_note: Lookout house moved to Morgan Butte in 1958; an OMNI range station was placed in service on the site in 1959. No source describes the site today.

staffing.status: Lookout duties moved to Morgan Butte in 1958; no later staffing at the Round Pass site in the sources read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says a 1922 house was replaced in 1930 with a 14x14 L-4 cab; firelookout.com gives a 14x14 cab for 1930 without naming the type. The Oregon lookouts page describes a 12x12 house built in 1922 and lists no 1930 replacement. The story reports both.

resolved_conflicts.field: Morgan Butte lookout and the moved house
resolved_conflicts.explanation: A trail listing dates the Morgan Butte lookout to 1958, the year the house moved there. No source says the two are the same building.

notes_for_editor: Facts cover the original Round Pass site; the moved house is covered under Morgan Butte in the story. Access is not set: Morgan Butte is described as closed to the public (trail listing), but no source describes access to the Round Pass site. Brief kind 'ground' was not checked against a source; the Oregon lookouts page's 1919 mention of 'the Round Pass Lookout Tower' suggests a tower may have existed there. Komoot is a weak source. Search results pages titled 'Printable Lookouts in Western Oregon' give a 1965 build date for Morgan Butte and are not used.
